dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, please. I want a shirt for my friend.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈpliːz. aɪ ˈwɑːnt ə ˈʃɜːrt fər maɪ ˈfrɛnd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: This striped shirt is very popular.
dialogue.reading: ðɪs ˈstraɪpt ˈʃɜːrt ɪz ˈvɛri ˈpɑːpjələr.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: No, it's cotton. The silk shirts are more expensive.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ɪts ˈkɑːtən. ðə ˈsɪlk ˈʃɜːrts ər ˈmɔːr ɪkˈspɛnsɪv.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Cotton is good. Do you have bags, too?
dialogue.reading: ˈkɑːtən ɪz ˈɡʊd. duː juː ˈhæv ˈbæɡz, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes. We have small black leather bags and big brown leather bags.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. wiː ˈhæv ˈsmɔːl ˈblæk ˈlɛðər ˈbæɡz ənd ˈbɪɡ ˈbraʊn ˈlɛðər ˈbæɡz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'll take the striped shirt and a small black leather bag.
dialogue.reading: aɪl ˈteɪk ðə ˈstraɪpt ˈʃɜːrt ənd ə ˈsmɔːl ˈblæk ˈlɛðər ˈbæɡ.
